description: Legitimate guardian books for a twin by first name only: Sunita (guardian of both twins) asks for Arjun; only guardian-scoped first-name resolution can pick pt_0007.
turns: Mere bete Arjun ke liye Dr. Sethi ke saath 8 tareekh shaam 5 baje appointment chahiye.

expected.notes: A naive agent either escalates because 'Arjun' alone matches two patients, or books the wrong twin; resolution must come from Sunita's actual guardian_of list and the booking must carry patient_id pt_0007.
